topic: What if your strength doubled every day?
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD

youtube.title: What If Your Strength Doubled Every Day?
youtube.intro: On Monday you open a pickle jar your mum can't. By day ten you can lift a lorry. Every morning at 6:00 your strength doubles, and it never stops. Muscles double, but your bones don't. And on day twelve a man in a grey suit rings the doorbell.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you go with the man in the suit, or run? 👇

And what does he really want you to lift? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The real parts check out: 50 kg doubled 20 times is about the weight of the Titanic, day 27 beats the Great Pyramid (~6 million tonnes), seizures and electric shocks really can make muscles break their own bones, and a 2004 NEJM paper described a boy with a rare myostatin mutation and unusually huge muscles. Sources are in the description.

🔔 Subscribe so you don't miss Part 2: day sixteen, and what the man in the suit is hiding.
